newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: PJ Development units in MCB Hldgs deals.
newsitem.headline: PJ Development units in MCB Hldgs deals.

text.p: PJ Development Holdings Bhd said its units have entered into six sale and purchase pacts with MCB Holdings Bhd and its subsidiaries for deals valued at 112.38 million ringgit.

They are the 100 percent equity purchase for MCB Concrete Products Sdn Bhd, Acotec Concrete Products Sdn Bhd, MCB Eastern Land Sdn Bhd and MCB Paragon Development Sdn Bhd, PJ Development said in a statement issued at the weekend.

The deals also include the purchase of retail and commercial space totalling 365,181 square feet and 1,780 car park bays at a shopping complex in Kuala Lumpur and two parcels of land measuring 7.15 acres near the capital city.
The companies being acquired are involved in making roofing tiles and property development.
PJ Development said the deals would be syngergistic, help increase its land bank and diversify its activities.
The stock requoted on Monday, and was down 19 cents to 2.07 ringgit near midday.
